Dual study program

  1. Home
  2. Careers
  3. Career Level
  4. Pupils
  5. Dual study program

The perfect combination of theory and practice

Would you like to start your career right after school and complete an academic degree in the meantime? The dual study program is the right choice for you. Because you will have the perfect mix of university theory and the real business practice.

We see a great advantage of this ambitious dual qualification and offer you that opportunity at almost every German Gerresheimer location. The pros are obvious: You complete a Bachelor degree and gain first work experience at the same time. You will build valuable contacts and eventually, you will be one step ahead after your studies.

The concept of the dual program is different depending on each state and location of the university. There are dual programs including an apprenticeship and there are more practically oriented programs. We primary offer technically oriented study programs. By the way: During the practical phases you will have the same Highlights as in our apprenticeships.

During the dual study program you will switch between a theoretical semester at the university and a practical semester in the company. Thereby, theory and practice are always well balanced.

Those programs are your entry ticket to Gerresheimer
